Definition: from G4272 (in the sense of giving forward into another's (the enemy's) hands); a surrender:--betrayer, traitor.
BiblicalUsage: Prodotes is the traitor, the betrayer, the one who gives into the enemy's hands. Luke names Judas Iscariot the traitor, and Stephen calls the rulers betrayers and murderers of the Just One.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that betrayal is the worst sin because it wears the face of a friend, and Judas is the warning to every disciple.
